## Services Offered

### Core Car Care Services
- **Denting** – Precision dent removal without filler shortcuts
- **Car Painting** – High-quality painting with 2K and Glasurit paints, perfect colour matching
- **Nano Coat** – Nano-technology coating, protective layer for 6-12 months
- **Ceramic Coat** – 9H ceramic protection, repels water/dirt/UV for 3-5 years (most popular)
- **Graphene Coat** – Next-gen graphene coating with superior hardness and heat resistance, 5-7 years
- **Rubbing & Polish** – Machine polishing eliminates swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation
- **Teflon Coating** – Protects paint from minor abrasions, dust, environmental damage
- **Interior Detailing** – Deep cleaning, steam treatment, leather conditioning
- **Underbody Anti-Rust** – Heavy-duty coating shields chassis from rust and corrosion
- **Glass Cooling Film** – Premium window films block heat and UV rays
- **Car Accessories** – Seat covers, mats, organizers
- **Water Wash** – Thorough exterior water wash
- **Colour Customization** – Full-body custom colour wraps and paint jobs

### Specialized Painting Services

## Premium Paints Used

### 2K Paints (Nexa Autocolor)
- Professional-grade two-component system with hardener
- 2-3x longer lasting than conventional paints
- Superior UV, chemical, and scratch resistance
- Official: [nexaautocolor.com](https://www.nexaautocolor.com/en-GB)

### Glasurit Premium Paints
- Manufactured in **Germany and France** (BASF Coatings group)
- Used by Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche
- Exceptional color accuracy and mirror-like finish
- Official: [glasurit.com](https://www.glasurit.com/en-int)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the difference between 2K paint and regular paint?**
A: 2K paint uses a hardener mixed with the base coat, creating a chemical reaction that produces a much harder, more durable finish. It lasts 2-3 times longer than conventional paints with superior UV and chemical resistance.

**Q: What is Glasurit paint and why is it premium?**
A: Glasurit is manufactured in Germany and France (BASF Coatings group), used by Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Porsche. It offers exceptional color accuracy, superior durability, and a mirror-like finish.

**Q: How long does ceramic coating last?**
A: Professional ceramic coating lasts 3-5 years with proper maintenance. Graphene coating lasts 5-7 years.

**Q: Do you offer warranty?**
A: Yes. Ceramic coating: 3-5 years. Graphene: 5-7 years. Paint jobs: comprehensive coverage. All with written warranty.

**Q: How much does car painting cost?**
A: Costs vary based on paint type (2K or Glasurit), car size, and finish. Contact +91 85199 57776 for a free quote.

**Q: Which districts do you serve?**
A: All 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh, plus customers from Telangana and Karnataka.
